_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/keywords/test_escapes_with.py. Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. t_woe_strider is Woe Strider's escape line and its 'escapes with two +1/+1 counters' rider on a vanilla 3/2 body. t_crypt_keeper (conditional_graveyard_cast.cards.json) is the other route out of the graveyard: a permission to cast it for its mana cost, which is not escaping.

cards.name: Test Woe Strider
cards.oracle_text:
Escape—{3}{B}{B}, Exile four other cards from your graveyard. (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its escape cost.)
This creature escapes with two +1/+1 counters on it.
